2511-4336-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
2511-4336-5006-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

5478-5531-5694-7874-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
5478-5531-5694-7874-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, The Immortal Weapons and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, The Immortal Weapons and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the The Immortal Weapons trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.
5478-5531-5694-7874-8110.notes:
If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink The Immortal Weapons and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6835-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

3899-4535--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-5478-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
4094-5478-6441-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

3478-4693-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Dimir Aqueduct.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Repeat.

301-7804-7859.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
301-7804-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin and then putting the card back on top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

104-3197-6890-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3197-6890-7810.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

1556-3819-5671.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Cultivator Colossus enters, it triggers, attempting to put Scorched Ruins from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Scorched Ruins into your graveyard.
Afterwards, continue resolving the Cultivator Colossus trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Scorched Ruins from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability. Then, repeat the process, attempting to put Scorched Ruins from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Scorched Ruins into your graveyard.
Repeat step 3.
1556-3819-5671.notes: You can return other lands with their dredge abilities instead, as you're able to do so.

215-4188-4785.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-4188-4785.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

140-2852-3245.description:
Activate Doom Whisperer by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

3605-4812-5231-6553.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1458-4404-4924.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4404-4924.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Heartless Summoning.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1806-2060-6627-6798-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to The Earth Crystal.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

1409-1449-6751.description:
Activate Plundering Barbarian by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Barbarian enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Plundering Barbarian.
Resolve both Plundering Barbarian triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

977-1020-2866-4009-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
977-1020-2866-4009-4659.description:
Announce the activation of Chromatic Star's ability, allowing you to activate mana abilities while delaying any triggered abilities until this ability has finished resolving.
Activate Mox Opal's mana ability by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing Mox Opal, Myr Retriever, and Krark-Clan Ironworks, adding six colorless mana.
Complete the activation of Chromatic Star by paying {1}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
When the artifacts go to the graveyard in steps 3 and 4, Myr Retriever triggers once, Scrap Trawler triggers four times, and Chromatic Star triggers once.
Resolve Chromatic Star's triggered ability, drawing a card.
Resolve Myr Retriever's triggered ability, returning Krark-Clan Ironworks from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Scrap Trawler's triggered ability from Krark-Clan Ironworks, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Scrap Trawler's triggered ability from Myr Retriever, returning Chromatic Star from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Scrap Trawler's triggered ability from Chromatic Star, returning Mox Opal from your graveyard to your hand.
The final Scrap Trawler triggered ability from Mox Opal fails to resolve due to lack of targets.
Cast Krak-Clan Ironworks, Myr Retriver, Chromatic Star, and Mox Opal by paying seven mana.
Repeat.
977-1020-2866-4009-4659.notes: The purpose the delay mentioned in step 1 is to wait until all relevant artifacts are in your graveyard before you have to select targets for triggered abilities.

2510-3140-7070.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3140-7070.description:
Activate Soltari Guerrillas by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Soltari Guerrillas.
The Soltari Guerrillas ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Soltari Guerrillas from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

3231-4613-4968-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Dictate of the Twin Gods.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1636-2527-3143-6798.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2527-3143-6798.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

2292-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
2292-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-5043-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2034-5043-5078-6650.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

1445-2279-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-4871-5256.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1287-3129-4918-6320.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner.
1287-3129-4918-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create two token copies of Aethertide Whale with haste.
When the Aethertide Whale tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Declare Lightning Runner as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to get {E}{E} and then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

6323-6327.easyPrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.
6323-6327.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Cast Dazzling Reflection by paying {1}{W}, targeting Jumbo Cactuar and causing you to gain 10,000 life.

2511-2781-4875-6243.easyPrerequisites: any type other than "Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
2511-2781-4875-6243.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Conspiracy. Choose any creature type except "Angel" as Conspiracy enters the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4359-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2558-5315-5687-5688.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Judith, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

3719-4753-4893-5326.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3719-4753-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Clever Impersonator has a power of at least 2.
3719-4753-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Clever Impersonator and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Clever Impersonator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Clever Impersonator to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Clever Impersonator by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1636-6063.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.
1170-1636-6063.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Viscerid Armor by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature you control except Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking itself.
When Displacer Kitten enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Viscerid Armor spell.
Activate Viscerid Armor by paying {1}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2324-3000-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
2324-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the creature's toughness.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

2653-5412-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
2653-5412-5720-5721.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Nissa triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Nissa's trigger.

859-1036-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
There is at least one Elf on the battlefield.
859-1036-4613.description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Wellwisher's ability by tapping it, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1365-2034-2198-2527-5294.easyPrerequisites:
Deceiver Exarch doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vohar doesn't have summoning sickness.
1365-2034-2198-2527-5294.description:
Activate Vohar's first ability by tapping it.
Vohar triggers, giving creatures you control that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Vohar ability from step 1, causing you to loot.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Deceiver Exarch persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Vohar.
Repeat.

2701-2825-3263-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
2701-2825-3263-3525.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Dark Ritual without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {3}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.

2198-2905-3358.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by sacrificing Corridor Montior, returning Deceiver Exarch from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Hell's Caretaker by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch, returning Pestermite from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Pestermite enters the battlefield, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Repeat.

2060-4222-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Vorel.
Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
Crystalline Crawler has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
2060-4222-4312.description:
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {G}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Vorel.
Repeat.

3492-3609-3849.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
3492-3609-3849.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Soul of Innistrad's first activated ability by paying {3}{B}{B}, returning Coretapper and up to two additional creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Coretapper by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

624-4050-5011.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phantasmal Image, adding one mana of any color.
When Phantasmal Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Repeat.

1367-4267.manaNeeded: {6}{U}{U}{B} AVAILABLE ON YOUR FIRST TURN, AND {5}{U}{U} AVAILABLE EACH EXTRA TURN
1367-4267.notablePrerequisites:
Divining Witch does not have summoning sickness.
At least one additional card in hand.
1367-4267.description:
Activate Divining Witch by paying {1}{B}, discarding a card, and tapping it, Divining Witch, naming a card not in your library and exiling your entire library.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one and shuffling Nexus of Fate into your empty library.
Draw Nexus of Fate on your next draw step.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

1335-1613-2757.notablePrerequisites: Verdant Haven attached to a basic land.
1335-1613-2757.description:
Activate the enchanted land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Verdant Haven triggers, adding an additional {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped creature, untapping the enchanted land.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental token.
Repeat until Marath has no more +1/+1 counters.
Marath dies due to having 0 toughness and goes to the command zone.
Cast Marath by paying {R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, leaving zero mana unspent.
Marath enters the battlefield with a number of +1/+1 counters equal to the amount of mana spent.
Repeat any number of times.

2104-2556-3632.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying {4}{U}.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
